_comment: Claims about other products. An article may name a product only through a fact listed in its frontmatter `facts`, and its Sources section is built from these entries, not written by the model. `quotes` must appear verbatim (whitespace-normalised) in the source page's visible text: automation/facts-check.mjs re-reads every source monthly and flags the fact when a quote disappears. `names` are the product names the fact allows an article to mention.
